name: Unchained Monk Monk of the Way
body:
Avowed to a personal or shared ideal, the monk of the way follows the teachings of his masters, and refines at maximum some of his abilities at the expense of others.

Way: A monk of the way dedicates himself to a monastic tradition, not very different from a cavalier or samurai order or a paladin oath. Together with an unique purpose and style of combat, each way grants a monk additional ki powers he can select, replaces other abilities and gives an ethics he must follow. Some monastic traditions may have alignment requirements different than usual for their adepts. A monk of the way can belong to multiple traditions, but none of them can replace or alter the same class feature from the monk class, nor can they have conflicting ethics.

A monk can abandon his way if he so chooses; when this choice is made, he immediately loses all of the benefits from his old way. He must then follow the ethics of his new way for one entire level without gaining any benefits from that way. Once accomplished, he gains all of the bonuses from his new way, just like a cavalier or samurai can change his chosen order. A monk who abandoned his way can in alternative choose to become a standard monk or a different monk archetype.

If a monk violates the ethics of his way, he loses the class abilities associated with that way for 24 hours.

A monk may choose among the following ways.

Way of the Creation Elements

The way of the creation is meant to build rather than destroy. A monk perfections his ability in the use of one element, aiming to establish true harmony between himself and nature, thus unblocking her true potential.

Ethics: To build is better than to destroy. Try to achieve harmony within and without and grow to your highest potential. The best way to vanquish a foe is to make them your friend.

Primary Element: At 1st level, the monk chooses a primary element from the kineticist’s list.

Elemental Fist (Su)

At 1st level, a monk of the creation elements gains Elemental Fist as a bonus feat, even if she does not meet the feat’s prerequisites. She can only deal additional energy damage of the type matching her primary element. If her primary element is not air, earth, fire, or water, the monk deals additional bludgeoning damage with Elemental Fist. This ability replaces stunning fist.

Ki Powers: A monk of the creation elements must select the following ki powers: elemental fury (6th level, stacks with Elemental Fist), whirlwind attack (8th level), elemental burst (18th level). In addition, any ki power duplicating the effects of a spell of the elemental school matching the monk’s chosen element is available 2 levels in advance to him; for example, cloak of winds can be selected at 4th level by a monk of air.

The monk also gains access to the following ki powers:

Elemental Defense (Sp)

A monk with this power the kineticist’s elemental defense tied to her primary element for 1 minute. Using this ability is a move action that consumes 1 point from the monk’s ki pool.

Elemental Kinesis (Sp)

A monk with this power gains an utility wild talent tied to her primary element (or an universal utility talent) as if he were a kineticist of her monk level. She can expend 2 ki points instead of 1 point of burn in order to use this talent. This power can be selected more than once, gaining a new utility talent each time.

Way of the Golden Streak

A monk of the golden streak is dedicated to speed.

Ethics: Use agility before force. Confuse and disarm your adversaries when you can. Always strike first once a fight is declared, and try to end the combat as soon as possible with the minimum of losses.

Fast Movement (Ex)

A golden streak monk gains the fast movement ability at 1st level, and the stunning fist ability at 3rd level.

Ki Powers: A monk of the golden streak must select the following ki powers: sudden speed (4th level), bladed dash (6th level), abundant step (8th level), ki hurricane (10th level), greater bladed dash (12th level). He also gains access to the following ki powers:

Kasoku (Ex)

When using the sudden speed and ki hurricane powers, a monk with this power can spend more ki points to further increase his speed. He adds another 10 feet to his base land speed for each additional ki point he spends. A monk must be at least 12th level and possess the sudden speed and ki hurricane powers before selecting this ki power.

Time Stop (Sp)

(20th level, 4 ki points).

Way of Indiscriminate Fighting

This way teaches the use of any means or weapons available in order to win.

Ethics: Never refuse a challenge. Don’t shun any useful tactics in a fight, ridiculous or improbable as it may be. Try to learn something from every school or style you enter in contact with.

Alignment: An indiscriminate fighting monk can have any non-lawful alignment.

Improvised Weapon (Ex)

At 1st level, an indiscriminate fighting monk gains Catch Off-Guard as a bonus feat. This replaces the 1st-level bonus feat.

Improbable Jutsu (Ex)

At 6th level, an indiscriminate fighting monk gains the martial flexibility class feature as a brawler of his level -5. He can use this power to gain combat feats or ki feats. This ability replaces the 6th and 18th-level bonus feats and the 12th and 16th-level ki powers.

Perfect Improvisation (Ex)

At 20th level, an indiscriminate fighting monk can gain the benefit of any number of combat feats as a swift action. Each feat selected counts toward his daily uses of the martial flexibility ability. This replaces perfect self (the monk can still gain perfect self as his 20th-level ki power).

Ki Powers: A monk of indiscriminate fighting must select the following ki power: Improvised Weapon Mastery (12th level). He also gains access to the following ki power:

Tactical Escape (Ex)

As a full-round action, a monk with this power can expend 1 ki point to move up to his speed away from a foe without provoking attacks of opportunity, while he thinks about the best way to attack or defend himself. In the round following the end of his tactical escape, he gains a +1 bonus on his attack rolls and CMB for each round spent running. A monk must be at least 8th level before selecting this ki power.

Way of the Northern Star

The way of the northern star stresses using ki for a variety of purposes. These monks manipulate the flow of ki in the human body to increase their abilities, damage enemies, and heal wounds. They believe in balance and compassion, but can be very straightforward when circumstances call for it.

Ethics: Act for the greater advantage of the world. Stay calm in all circumstances, but don’t fear to show your feelings. Learn new styles both from allies and enemies.

Flurry of a Thousands Blows (Ex)

A monk of the northern star adds one additional attack to his flurry of blows at 3rd and 15th level, in addition to the other attacks normally gained. This replaces fast movement and timeless body.

Ninja Tricks

A monk of the northern star can select the following ninja tricks in place of ki powers, using his monk level as his ninja level for the purpose of gaining and using them. If a ninja trick improves a ninja’s sneak attack, it applies to the monk’s flurry of blows instead.

Ninja Tricks

Acrobatic master, bleeding attack, blood debt, breath of the ancestor, combat trick, darkvision, deadly range, deflect arrows, forgotten trick, ki block, ki charge, pressure points, redirect force, slow metabolism, slow reactions, style master, weapon training.

Master Tricks

see the unseen, unbound steps, vested power.

Ki Powers: A monk of the northern star must select the following ki powers: Psychic Sensitivity (4th level), explode head (12th level). He also gains access to the following ki power:

Delayed Damage (Su)

Whenever a monk with this power would deliver damage to an opponent, he can spend 1 ki point from his pool to delay the damage’s onset by 1 round.

Way of the Southern Star

A southern star monk dedicates to an ideal, be it good, evil, love, kindness, duty, or sacrifice.

Ethics: Be faithful to your values. Strive to guide others to see the beauty of your ideals. Take every opportunity to teach what you have learned.

Alignment: A monk of the southern star can be of any alignment.

Chosen Virtue (Ex)

At 1st level, a monk of the southern star must select one alignment. As long as he maintains the selected alignment, he receives a +2 morale bonus to one saving throw of his choice.

Blessing: At 8th level, a monk of the southern star selects one warpriest minor blessing suited to his ideals and alignment. He can use the minor power of that blessing as a warpriest of the same level. At 16th level, the monk gains his blessing’s major power too. This replaces the 8th and 16th-level ki powers.

Perfect Ideal: At 20th level, when a monk of the southern star gains the perfect self ability, his damage reduction applies to an alignment of his choice (chaotic, evil, good, or lawful) that is opposite to her own. This modifies perfect self.

Ki Powers: A monk of the southern star must select the following ki power: one touch (12th level). He also gains access to the following ki powers:

Virtuous Creed (Ex)

(4th level, 0 ki points)

Versatile weapon (Sp)

(6th level, 1 ki point)
